chunks: Ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Ḥammād ibn Ziyād, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who said to his wife, after he had consummated the marriage with her, “I did not find you a virgin,” he عليه السلام said: “There is no legal punishment upon him.”

key_terms.دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ: he consummated the marriage with her

ai.seo_question: Is there a hadd punishment for a husband who tells his wife after consummation that he did not find her a virgin?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband who says to his wife after consummation that he did not find her to be a virgin. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that no hadd punishment applies to him in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5064 - Ibn Mahbub narrated from Hammad ibn Ziyad from Sulayman ibn Khalid from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who said to his wife after consummating the marriage, "I did not find you a virgin"
Imam (as) said: "There is no legal punishment upon him."
